limitations: The selection/enqueue receipt is not equivalent to successful downloads. One job failed at optional cover-art retrieval after slskd reported its audio transfer completed. It has no app output and is not counted as a managed saved download.

Twelve app job outputs exist and decode as FLAC at 44.1 kHz stereo. Each output has exactly one local_assets row at its output path; all twelve live file hashes match that row, the asset recording identity matches the requested catalog track, and the stored source peer/filename match the selected candidate. For tracks 5, 11, 12, and 13, the job payload’s `track.assetId` points to a different asset for the same catalog recording; exact-output-path reconciliation confirms the output is registered, so this is not a missing binding.

All twelve completed app outputs match expected artist/title/album/label and release-date metadata. Release date is stored under the normalized RELEASE_DATE tag key. Expected ISRCs match where present in catalog metadata; no expected ISRC is recorded for four tracks.
The separate raw transfer and user/device identifiers are excluded. No audio or database changes, retries, or new jobs were made.
